Load Calculations Sample (Seattle City Light - Commercial/Multifamily)

agency: Seattle Department of Construction and Inspections (SDCI)

code_edition.quote: 2023 Seattle Electrical Code. Quick Reference of Seattle Changes to 2023 NEC® Effective: November 15, 2024.

who_may_file.conditions: Homeowner must perform their own work; if not doing the work, must hire an electrical contractor.
who_may_file.quote: As a homeowner, can I apply for a permit? Yes, if you perform your own work. If you're not doing the work, you must hire an electrical contractor.

requirements.item: Complete online Electric Service Application for existing service alteration, removal, new permanent service, or solar interconnection
requirements.quote: An electric service application is required for: Existing service alteration or removal. Permanent service for any new construction. Temporary service for construction sites. Construction clearance. New streetlight service. Solar interconnection.

requirements.item: Contact assigned Electric Service Representative (ESR) and submit electrical service application package
requirements.quote: 1. Contact an electric service representative (ESR) for your location. North of Denney Way (206) 615-0600; South of Denny Way (206) 386-4200. 2. Complete and submit your electrical service application package.

open_questions: SDCI requires load calculations in accordance with NEC Article 220 for plan review submittals, but no Seattle-specific single-family residential load calculation worksheet, mandatory 220.82 vs. 220.83 subsection, or EV charger load factor was found on seattle.gov; confirm with SDCI electrical inspections whether OTC residential permits require a specific NEC 220 method.

SDCI's Electrical Permit webpage (https://www.seattle.gov/construction-and-inspections/permits/permits-we-issue-(a-z)/electrical-permit) still states 'under 7.7KW' for no-plan-review solar PV, while the 2020/2023 SEC Section 80.51 text (https://www.seattle.gov/Documents/Departments/SDCI/Permits/SubmittalRequirementsforElectricalPlanReview.pdf) raised the threshold to 12 kW; confirm the active OTC PV threshold with SDCI.

Tip 339 (https://www.seattle.gov/DPD/Publications/CAM/cam339.pdf) is dated October 15, 2015 and focuses on commercial/life-safety systems; confirm with SDCI whether single-family optional standby or portable generators with interlocks/transfer switches qualify for OTC permits or require plan review under 2023 SEC Section 80.51.

No Seattle-specific residential electrical load calculation worksheet or EV charger load factor was found in the retrieved SDCI documents; confirm whether SDCI requires a specific NEC 220 method for single-family OTC permits.

load_calculation.quote: a complete project load summary to include existing loads as computed in accordance with NEC Article 220, and all added loads.

checklist.title: Submittal Requirements for Electrical Plan Review (Section 80.51)

requirements.item: Apply online via Seattle Services Portal for OTC permit (single-family); submit plans electronically if plan review required
requirements.quote: Most permits – You can apply online by choosing the Permit – Trade, Construction, and Land Use link and then selecting the appropriate electrical permit. You can print your permit the same day.

requirements.item: Complete set of switchboard and panel schedules when plan review is required
requirements.quote: (e) a complete set of switchboard and panel schedules.

requirements.item: Fault current calculations and listed interrupting rating of all feeder and service equipment (when plan review required)
requirements.quote: (g) fault current calculations and the listed interrupting rating of all feeder and service equipment;

requirements.item: Service inspection required before energizing the electrical service
requirements.quote: Service inspection - The service is generally the first electrical panel or disconnect on the property. Before energizing a service, it must be inspected.

sheet_requirements.copies_or_format: Electronic upload through Seattle Services Portal when plan review is required; drawn to clearly indicated commonly accepted scale
sheet_requirements.quote: Plans shall be drawn to a clearly indicated and commonly accepted scale. The plans shall be of sufficient quality to be easily read.
